_comments: CALIBRATED against REAL captured frames of OWCS 2026 | NA/EMEA | Stage 2
Playoffs Day 3, YouTube VOD nD5lLLWDkY0 (source id owcs-nd5lllwdky0), a
9h28m broadcast containing MANY matches.
Timeline established by actually viewing frames: ~40:24 is the match
intro / map-pick card (Geekay Esports vs a Twisted Minds-style pink-fist
logo, 'Lower Final', 'FT3') -- NOT gameplay. Live gameplay is up by
~40:30. slots_a/slots_b were calibrated on 0:41:00-0:41:20 (Twisted Minds
vs Geekay Esports, Control, First to 3), where all 10 hero portraits are
visible: 30/30 crops, 3/3 frames pass the filter.
ANCHOR CHOICE MATTERS MORE THAN IT LOOKS. The first anchor cut here was
the centre round-state row, which on the calibration frame reads
'0  0%  <lock>  0%  0'. That is match-state-specific: on an Escort map
mid-series the same region reads 'STOP THE PAYLOAD ... 1 / 2'. Measured
against a real full-HUD Escort frame at ~2:04:00 it scored -0.15 and the
filter silently threw away genuine gameplay. The anchor is now the
persistent broadcast chyron 'OWCS 2026 | STAGE 2 | PLAYOFFS', which is
invariant across matches, maps, modes and scores. Measured scores:
live gameplay, Control map 1 .......  0.92 - 1.00
live gameplay, Escort map 4 (1-2) ...  0.82
post-event champions graphic ........ -0.03
REPLAY (overlay hides the chyron) ...  0.06
min_score 0.55 sits in the wide gap. Rejecting replays matters: a replay
renders a full HUD showing a PAST comp.
Because the anchor is production-level rather than match-level, this
layout is reusable for every match in this VOD and for other VODs from
the same OWCS 2026 Stage 2 Playoffs production.
This VOD only reliably section-downloads as the 640x360 progressive
format (itag 18) -- the DASH video-only formats (135/298/299, VP9, AV1)
stall or 403 on --download-sections for this video specifically, so the
fallback ladder lands on 640x360 even with --height 1080. All rects were
measured in 640x360 space and stored at an exact 3x scale (1920x1080),
so scale_layout_to_frame maps them back losslessly at run time. Boxes
hug each portrait closely but are not sub-pixel precise at this source
resolution.
templates_dir points at this source's own (not yet harvested) template
set -- detection stays honestly 'skipped' until templates exist.
